description.value: Buy Low Foods is a full-service supermarket chain operating under the Pattison Food Group umbrella, serving communities across British Columbia. The North Vancouver location is a conventional neighbourhood supermarket stocking a broad range of grocery staples, produce, and in-house Western Family and Only Goodness branded products. Cyclists passing through North Vancouver can use it as a resupply point for food and household essentials.
